messages:
maya: Heads-up: PR asked for an embargo rehearsal + livestream mock for the marketplace listing. We also need a tenant cutover dry-run that morning. Can we confirm owners and timelines?
olivia: I can coordinate the rehearsal and run the livestream checklist. Prefer Wed morning rehearsal so partners in EU can join.
raj: I'll own tenant cutover dry-run. Need a snapshot of the staging catalog and a pinned shortlink for the embed.
sara: PR note: livestream requires 1) final quote from partner, 2) 2 images (hero + thumbnail), 3) caption copy. We need those 48h prior to publish for embargo.
lia: Ill do localized captions for EN/DE/FR. Anna's team can supply thumbnails.
hugo: Design update: hero + thumbnail first pass by Tue 10:00 PT. We can produce a 16:9 hero and a 1:1 thumbnail.
maya: Perfect. Raj, what time do you want the cutover dry-run?
raj: Target dry-run: Thu 02:00-03:00 UTC. We need SI to onboard one partner tenant and validate routing and billing flags.
tom: SI will need a schema/handshake sample and a small curl example. Pasting minimal handshake here: ```
POST /v1/tenants/register
{
  "tenant_id": "acme-123",
  "region": "eu-west-1",
  "callback_url": "https://hooks.example.com/tenant-cb"
}
```
sara: For press copy I'll prepare 75/100/180 char variants + a 400-word blog draft. Will tag partners for quotes.
olivia: Livestream tech question: do we host the player on our CDN or embed partner player? Pros/cons?
hugo: Recommend our CDN for consistent analytics and HLS fallback. Partner player may have branding conflicts.
lia: Localization note: ensure hero text is in assets for each locale; design must provide layered PSDs so we can swap text.
deploy-bot: infra: scheduled shortlink provisioning for staging: https://rwd.st/marketplace-staging-4287 created.
raj: got the shortlink, thanks. I'll use that in the SI runbook.
maya: Blockers: legal wants any comparison claims removed until partner signs off. Kevin, can you confirm legal review ETA?
hugo: tagging kevin in thread (DM sent)
olivia: Also PR wants a screenshot of the listing with the live tile and hero. Raj, can staging render a static snapshot at T-minus 48h?
raj: yes, will capture and upload to the shared folder.
tom: SI test plan (short) ```
- allocate tenant slot
- register tenant via POST /v1/tenants/register
- smoke: send 50 requests over 10m, check latency p50/p95
- billing: verify metering events emitted
- rollback: re-route tenant to control pool
- contacts: raj, tom, si-oncall@example.com
```
sara: I'll stitch the screenshot into the blog draft and pass to partners for quote. Can we get partner legal signoff by Wed EOD?
maya: If we hit these cutoffs, embargo go-live looks safe for Fri 09:00 PT.
hugo: Small ask from design: what copy goes over the hero illustration? Short headline + 1-line subhead.
lia: Draft headline: "Redwood Inference on Cloud Marketplace" subhead: "Deploy low-latency inference with predictable economics." Will localize.
olivia: Action items recap:
- maya: run embargo rehearsal (Wed 09:00 UTC) invite + script
- sara: press copy + blog + 3 blurb lengths (Tue 5pm PT)
- hugo/design: hero + thumbnail first pass (Tue 10am PT)
- raj: staging snapshot + shortlink + cutover runbook (Wed 02:00 UTC dry-run)
- tom: SI test harness + handshake example (Tue EOD)
- lia: localized captions and layered assets (Wed 8am PT)
- kevin/legal: confirm signoff timeline (TBD)
Any final flags? :eyes:
kevin: legal asked to review the 1-line subhead for any overclaiming. Please send exact text for review ASAP.
maya: I'll DM the exact strings now. Thanks everyone, will post rehearsal calendar invite. :raised_hands:
